description: A React component for rendering and managing a list of selectable user options in a multi-select interface, specifically for starting new direct message channels or adding users to existing channels in Mattermost.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders the username of a user profile for display in the multi-select component.

methods.name: renderAriaLabel
methods.description: Provides an accessible label for options, defaulting to username.
